messages.content: I don't understand recursion.
recursion is when a function calls itself until it remembers that somebody eventually has to tell it to stop.
Explain APIs simply.
your app asks another app for something. the API is the waiter carrying the request between tables.
Explain databases simply.
it's an organized place for your app to store information instead of writing everything on sticky notes.
Explain neural networks simply.
lots of adjustable numbers learn patterns from examples and then use those patterns to make predictions.
Explain training an AI.
show the model examples, measure how wrong its predictions are, adjust its parameters, repeat approximately an unreasonable number of times.
Why is training expensive?
because GPUs are doing an absolutely disrespectful amount of math over enormous datasets for hours, days, or months.
Can I make my own chatbot?
yes. use an existing model first. building the interface and retrieval system is far easier than training a foundation model from scratch.
I want my AI to talk like me.
collect examples of the desired style, remove low-quality/repetitive data, then fine-tune with LoRA or use a carefully designed system prompt.
I want my AI to be funny.
funny is not one magic parameter. train on varied examples with timing, context, tone, and restraint.
I want maximum brainrot.
understood. deploy the linguistic equivalent of a shopping cart rolling downhill with no brakes.
